review: I like the one-mechanic-per-stage structure: First Steps teaches gaps and one spike pair, Spike Garden builds on it, and Gauntlet remixes everything as a proper final exam. Laser Gate and Crumble Bridge read clearly and sit in a fair band. But Spring Loaded is broken: all 100 ghosts stall at the first spring before the spike field, so the spring is never taught and the stage cannot be finished. Saw Mill spikes too early for stage 3, with many drifting saws and deaths spread over the plateau. Ferry Lines loses 43 players to pits with no visible cue for platform timing.
best: Gauntlet combines saws, crumble tiles, ferries, a spring and lasers in a readable final exam with a 60% pass rate.
worst: Spring Loaded is impossible: nobody gets past the first spring at 38%, so the game cannot be completed.
